author_message: If run is stopped again pls resume unless it’s a major blocker and you need my guidance
authorization: Standing permission to investigate and autonomously recover routine execution interruptions in the already approved4320-outcome main study. Do not ask again for a routine recovery within these bounds.

bounds.provider_caps: Original caps unchanged; no increases or transfers.
bounds.science: Frozen model panel, prompts, generation settings, task allocation, oracles, measurement rules, endpoints and prespecified analyses unchanged.
bounds.concurrency: At most2inflight model calls/provider,60newoutputs/provider/batch,4credential-free evaluation shards/provider batch, one measurement at a time/host and all9measurements/program on one host.
bounds.preservation: All existing accepted/consumed outcomes, source bytes, raw streams, attempts, invoices/usage evidence, original ledgers/archives and repeat flags stay preserved; no repair, replacement, selective regeneration or duplicate accepted calls.
bounds.single_use_launch: Discover original run if dispatch outcome is uncertain. Each necessary new scoped recovery has a fresh recorded single-use launch after exact-commit software-only tests complete/success. Never blindly rerun a workflow or clear durable guards.
bounds.financial_recovery: For a routine interrupted/rejected request whose actual usage is missing, retain unknown usage and account conservatively at its existing full reviewed per-request allowance only on an annotated copied ledger, with exact attempt/source hashes and standing author approval linked. Proceed only if original cumulative/provider caps remain satisfied and the conservative amount is defensible. Never invent zero usage or verified invoice costs; no blanket deletion of uncertain attempts.
bounds.no_other_actions: No key-value retrieval, local execution of generated programs, manuscript edit, contact, submission or model calls beyond4320.

major_blockers: Original cumulative/provider cap exhaustion, requested increase/transfer, or billing exposure that cannot defensibly fit the reviewed bounds.
Evidence corruption, source/record/usage linkage mismatch, unexplained duplicates or an audit discrepancy that would require weakening guards.
A remedy requiring changed science, prompts, settings, model allocation, source repair/replacement, oracle semantics or measurement rules.
Unresolvable dispatch ambiguity or an issue requiring account access/credentials or a scientific decision from the author.
routine_recovery_workflow: Preserve partial/terminal evidence and independently establish the exact failure and accepted/unmade coordinate set.
Use saved sources/evaluations wherever valid; generate only genuinely unmade coordinates under the original retry policy.
Prepare a versioned scoped recovery in a separate copy/branch, preserve original financial records and test all changed controls.
Require successful original-attempt exact-commit software gate, then one recorded launch. Restore/continue hourly health checks.
Keep quiet for healthy operation and routine recoveries; report major blockers or completion once.
